original_user_question: 你好，给我看看 近期的就是 对中国最相关的 报道我看看

expected_behavior.intent: China-related recent report lookup, natural-language chat
expected_behavior.retrieval: discard greeting/filler/action grammar; retain actual topic/entity/date constraints; no silent date relaxation
expected_behavior.analysis: Chinese synthesis with C-source references and explicit sample/date limits; SQL-derived counts use aggregate references
expected_behavior.conversation: inherit user topic and selected institutions for followups; preserve/override axes explicitly
expected_behavior.feedback: request activity visible, result scroll reachable, cancel/retry and helpful empty response
expected_behavior.dates: latest available matching snapshot records are not real-time news; explicit days use Asia/Shanghai actual calendar

required_live_acceptance: actual analytical answer, not only verbatim extracts
institution comparison with evidence for both institutions
latency_policy: Resolve obvious grammar, aliases, structured count and bounded query planning without an unnecessary model roundtrip; call model for evidence-grounded synthesis when needed and report actual participation.

model_output_policy.source_review: bounded separate evidence review, no retries or unsupported pass on timeout

source_supported_named_entities: Retain exact handles and person names supplied by cited evidence; do not expand handles into full names or infer affiliations from database institution attribution.
comparison_completion: Both institutions have evidence, and the answer explicitly states supported common themes and sample differences or clearly explains why a requested difference cannot be inferred.
answer_render_policy: Successful API answer is rendered before local snapshot citation enrichment; a slow or unavailable full local index must not leave a completed model response appearing unresponsive.
unsupported_engine_explanations: Source-grounded answers discuss source content. Unsupported explanations about lexical matching, token boundaries or why a record was retrieved are rejected; unrelated sources are omitted.
